title: SFT Best Practices and Techniques
overview: 监督的Fine-Tuning(SFT)是RLHF输油管的基础。 SFT模型的质量决定了RL能够实现的上限:RL可以完善和改进一种行为，但它不能可靠地引入一种完全没有在SFT模型中的行为。本节涵盖有效SFT的关键技术。

监督的Fine-Tuning(SFT)是RLHF输油管的基础。 SFT模型的质量决定了RL能够实现的上限:RL可以完善和改进一种行为，但它不能可靠地引入一种完全没有在SFT模型中的行为。本节涵盖有效SFT的关键技术。
blocks.originalExcerpt: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) is the foundation of the RLHF pipeline. The quality of the SFT model determines the ceiling of what RL can achieve: RL can refine and improve a behaviour, but it cannot reliably introduce a behaviour that is entirely absent from the SFT model. This section covers the key techniques for effective SFT.

铺垫问题标准SFT批次将所有序列都铺到批次中最长序列的长度。对于长度差异很大的数据集(例如，短指令和长文档的混合)，这种在垫币上浪费了50-80%的计算。 顺序包装消除了这种浪费。序列包装将多个短例组合成一个长度的单序列 max seq 长度，由 EOS 符牌分隔。注意面罩确保不同实例的符牌不互相关注 :
blocks.originalExcerpt: The Padding Problem Standard SFT batches pad all sequences to the length of the longest sequence in the batch. For datasets with high length variance (e.g., a mix of short instructions and long documents), this wastes 50–80% of compute on padding tokens. Sequence packing eliminates this waste. Sequence packing concatenates multiple short examples into a sing...

blocks.text: 1. 按长度排序实例(可选，可提高包装效率)。
blocks.originalExcerpt: 1. Sort examples by length (optional, improves packing efficiency).

blocks.text: 2. 贪婪地将实例装入最大长度的桶中。
blocks.originalExcerpt: 2. Greedily pack examples into bins of size max_seq_length.

blocks.text: 3.使用块状对角注意罩防止交叉注意。
blocks.originalExcerpt: 3. Use a block-diagonal attention mask to prevent cross-example attention.

blocks.text: 4. 仅计算非打字证的损失。
blocks.originalExcerpt: 4. Compute loss only on non-padding tokens.

blocks.text: 包装效率
blocks.originalExcerpt: Packing Efficiency
• Typical packing efficiency: 85–95% (vs 20–50% with padding).

blocks.text: • 速度:2-4×用于长度差异大的数据组。
blocks.originalExcerpt: • Speedup: 2–4× for datasets with high length variance.

blocks.text: • 记忆:类似于贴纸(每批的纪念品总数相同)。
blocks.originalExcerpt: • Memory: similar to padding (same total tokens per batch).

blocks.text: • 洞穴:需要小心地注意遮掩，以避免交叉污染。
blocks.originalExcerpt: • Caveat: requires careful attention masking to avoid cross-contamination.

为什么Chat Templates Matter Language 模型都接受了原始文本的培训，但遵循指令的模型需要区分系统提示，用户消息，以及助理响应。聊天模板将这个结构编码为符号序列。在推断时间使用错误的模板(或没有模板)会导致显著的性能退化。
blocks.originalExcerpt: Why Chat Templates Matter Language models are trained on raw text, but instruction-following models need to distinguish between system prompts, user messages, and assistant responses. Chat templates encode this structure into the token sequence. Using the wrong template (or no template) at inference time causes significant performance degradation.

为什么将“提示”遮住?在指示微调中，模型应该学会生成助手的响应，而不是预测用户的问题或系统是否及时。快速信号的计算损失会引发废物梯度信号，并导致模型“记忆”引发而不是学会应对。 仅用完成的掩码会将所有非辅助信号的损失定为零。
blocks.originalExcerpt: Why Mask the Prompt? In instruction fine-tuning, the model should learn to generate the assistant’s response, not to predict the user’s question or the system prompt. Computing loss on the prompt tokens wastes gradient signal and can cause the model to “memorise” prompts rather than learning to respond to them. Completion-only masking sets the loss to zero f...

关于多个任务的多任务挑战培训可以同时改进概括性，但也会造成任务干扰:不同任务产生的梯度冲突，降低单个任务的表现。数据混合策略控制了每项任务对训练信号的相对贡献。
blocks.originalExcerpt: The Multi-Task Challenge Training on multiple tasks simultaneously can improve generalisation but also causes task interference: gradients from different tasks conflict, degrading performance on individual tasks. Data mixing strategies control the relative contribution of each task to the training signal.

sections.enTitle: When SFT Hurts – Catastrophic Forgetting and Alignment
sections.zhTitle: 当SFT伤害时 — 灾难性遗忘和对齐

blocks.title: 编者阅读提示
blocks.text: 阅读 §10.5「当SFT伤害时 — 灾难性遗忘和对齐」 时，以页面标注的原文范围为证据边界：先确认术语定义，再追踪机制、前提、例子与限制，最后检查结论能否迁移到不同规模或不同数据条件。以下译述保留这些层次，不把编者判断混入原文。
法学硕士通过连续培训阶段——培训前阶段——继续培训前阶段——过渡时，学习成绩下降往往表现在标准基准上。有两个根本不同的现象驱动这些倒退，混淆它们导致错误的缓解战略。
blocks.originalExcerpt: Tax As LLMs transition through sequential training phases — pre-training → continued pre-training → SFT → RLHF/DPO — performance degradation frequently manifests on standard benchmarks. Two fundamentally distinct phenomena drive these regressions, and confusing them leads to wrong mitigation strategies.

sections.zhTitle: 灾难性遗忘(结构化 Erasure)

blocks.originalExcerpt: Catastrophic Forgetting Catastrophic forgetting is an unintentional optimization failure: when a network optimized on distribution DA is subsequently trained on a disjoint distribution DB , the weight updates required for DB physically overwrite the parameter structures encoding DA :

blocks.text: 阅读 §10.5.2「对齐税(行为约束)」 时，把训练数据、优化目标、更新信号、reference 或 baseline、计算代价和稳定性约束放在同一张因果图里。算法名称本身不是结论，真正需要核对的是它改变了哪一个信号，以及为此引入了什么偏差。

blocks.expression: The alignment tax is a deliberate, expected trade-off : the model’s raw capability (unconstrained generation, maximal reasoning bandwidth) decreases because the policy is constrained to produce safe, well-formatted, preference-aligned outputs. Mechanism: During DPO/PPO, the policy πθ is penalized for deviating from the reference πref via KL divergence: πθ (y|x) rimplicit (x, y) = β log (10.3) πref (y|x) This leash constrains the model’s output distribution — it cannot explore high-variance reasoning paths that deviate too far from the reference. The knowledge is not erased; it’s suppressed. The model still “knows” the answer but its distribution is flattened toward safe, generic responses. Symptoms:

blocks.title: 编者阅读提示
blocks.text: 阅读 §10.6「连接到 RL — SFT 质量决定 RL 上限」 时，以页面标注的原文范围为证据边界：先确认术语定义，再追踪机制、前提、例子与限制，最后检查结论能否迁移到不同规模或不同数据条件。以下译述保留这些层次，不把编者判断混入原文。
SFT-RL关系 STFT模式是RL训练的起点。 RL可以:
blocks.originalExcerpt: The SFT-RL Relationship The SFT model is the starting point for RL training. RL can:

blocks.text: • 扩大在SFT模式中存在但软弱的行为。
blocks.originalExcerpt: • Amplify behaviours that are present but weak in the SFT model.

blocks.text: • 禁止存在但不受欢迎的行为。
blocks.originalExcerpt: • Suppress behaviours that are present but undesirable.

blocks.text: · 改进答复的风格和格式。
blocks.originalExcerpt: • Refine the style and format of responses.

blocks.text: • 引进SFT模式中完全没有的能力。
blocks.originalExcerpt: • Introduce capabilities that are entirely absent from the SFT model.

blocks.text: • 从SFT阶段的严重灾难性遗忘中恢复过来。
blocks.originalExcerpt: • Recover from severe catastrophic forgetting in the SFT stage.

blocks.text: • 对一贯带有偏见的奖励模式给予补偿。
blocks.originalExcerpt: • Compensate for a reward model that is systematically biased.

blocks.text: SFT中的探索-开发权衡(Exploration-Expective Tradeoff)为RL工作， SFT模式必须偶尔产生正确的响应(因此奖励信号为非零)。如果 SFT 模型从未对给定的提示产生正确的响应， RL 就无法学习产生正确的响应 — — 没有正信号可以放大。 这就是为什么 SFT 质量是 RL 性能的上限。具体来说:如果SFT模型正确解决了10%的数学问题， RL可以将这个比例推到80%。如果SFT模型解决了0%的数学问题， RL将不会取得任何进展(所有的奖励都是零，所有的优点都是零，没有梯度)。
blocks.originalExcerpt: The Exploration-Exploitation Tradeoff in SFT For RL to work, the SFT model must occasionally produce correct responses (so the reward signal is non-zero). If the SFT model never produces a correct response to a given prompt, RL cannot learn to produce correct responses – there is no positive signal to amplify. This is why SFT quality is the ceiling for RL pe...

blocks.text: SFT 最佳做法摘要
blocks.originalExcerpt: SFT Best Practices Summary

blocks.text: 1. 使用序列包装，最大限度地利用GPU。
blocks.originalExcerpt: 1. Use sequence packing to maximise GPU utilisation.

blocks.text: 2. 采用只完成的遮盖，将梯度集中于助理响应。
blocks.originalExcerpt: 2. Apply completion-only masking to focus gradient on assistant responses.

blocks.text: 3. 为您的模范家庭使用正确的聊天模板。
blocks.originalExcerpt: 3. Use the correct chat template for your model family.

blocks.text: 4. 多任务SFT的温度缩放(T Q II)比例混合数据。
blocks.originalExcerpt: 4. Mix data proportionally with temperature scaling (T ≈ 2) for multi-task SFT.

blocks.text: 5. 利用LORA防止灾难性的遗忘。
blocks.originalExcerpt: 5. Use LoRA to prevent catastrophic forgetting.

blocks.text: 6。在启动RL前评估通过@k，以确保SFT模型是一个可行的起点。
blocks.originalExcerpt: 6. Evaluate pass@k before starting RL to ensure the SFT model is a viable starting point.

blocks.text: 7。不要过量的训练:通常1-3个时代足以进行教学微调。
blocks.originalExcerpt: 7. Do not over-train: 1–3 epochs is usually sufficient for instruction fine-tuning.

blocks.text: 8。监测多样性的衡量标准(entropy， n-gm diversity)，以检测模式崩溃。
blocks.originalExcerpt: 8. Monitor diversity metrics (entropy, n-gram diversity) to detect mode collapse.

summary: 监督的Fine-Tuning(SFT)是RLHF输油管的基础。 SFT模型的质量决定了RL能够实现的上限:RL可以完善和改进一种行为，但它不能可靠地引入一种完全没有在SFT模型中的行为。本节涵盖有效SFT的关键技术。
铺垫问题标准SFT批次将所有序列都铺到批次中最长序列的长度。对于长度差异很大的数据集(例如，短指令和长文档的混合)，这种在垫币上浪费了50-80%的计算。 顺序包装消除了这种浪费。序列包装将多个短例组合成一个长度的单序列 max seq 长度，由 EOS 符牌分隔。注意面罩确保不同实例的符牌不互相关注 :
1. 按长度排序实例(可选，可提高包装效率)。
